newsitem.title: UK: BTR to announce disposals target -paper.
newsitem.headline: BTR to announce disposals target -paper.

text.p: Industrial conglomerate BTR Plc is to announce a 2.0 billion stg disposals programme and a restructuring when it announces its interim results this week, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper said.
The paper said Ian Strachan, who was appointed as chief executive earlier this year, is expected to say he intends to raise 2.0 billion stg by the end of next-year by selling non-core businesses.
This process will start with the sale this week of Taita Chemical, a Taiwanese polymer producer, for 200 million stg, it added.

The paper said Strachan would also announce the results of an internal strategic review, with BTR expected to be reorganised into six or seven divisions. These will be based on its main product groups and will each be headed by executives.

The Sunday Telegraph said Strachan is expected to say BTR will concentrate on sales growth rather than improving profit margin and the 2.0 billion stg from disposals will be invested in capital expenditure and "in-fill acquisitions" to give businesses a global dimension.

Officials at BTR were not immediately available for comment on the report, which said disposal candidates include ACI Fibreglass, Mirrlees Blackstone, Rocla Pipelines in Australia, Commercial Interiors in the U.S., Feltex carpets in New Zealand and Dunlopillo beds in the UK.
